summary: His sister Eutris lists eight brothers and six sisters.

blocks.x: Now, you're Eutris? What's your married name now?
Earlier we were asking Jay C. about all the members
of the family and he gave us a list but not - there were 6 sisters and 7 brothers?
Would you name the brothers for me?

Yes, I remember them. My oldest brother was named Charles - I think you have Charles. The next brother was Fletcher. You don't have Fletcher. Garnett. Walter. Marion. Robert. Then the twins, Jay C. and C. B. How many do you have there?
L-u-c-i-o-u-s, I think. That's the way I spell it.
He died when he was a baby.
So we have that. ... The oldest brother was Charles,
then Fletcher, Garnett, Walter, Marion, then the twins Jay C. and C. D., and then Lucious?
And the sisters - Pauline, Emma, Stella, Annie, Atrina, and Eutris. Do you mind if I call you Eutris?
